input: Find dance and ballet summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: dance summer camps Hendersonville NC studio 2026

candidates.name: Ballet Conservatory of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 ballet workshops, summer classes for ages 3+, and a four-week intensive with housing options.

candidates.name: Center Stage AVL
candidates.note: South Asheville theme and ballet camps, plus 2026 hip-hop, modern and multi-style intensives.

candidates.name: The Asheville Ballet / Asheville Academy of Ballet and Contemporary Dance
candidates.note: North Asheville summer classes for ages 3+ and 2026 Blue Ridge Dance Camp for ages 11–18.

candidates.name: Asheville Contemporary Dance Theatre / New Studio of Dance
candidates.note: Downtown studio published summer 2026 camps and intensives at 20 Commerce Street.

candidates.name: Asheville Dance Theater
candidates.note: Fairview Road studio offers themed summer camps combining dance, musical theater and crafts.

candidates.name: In His Steps Dance Ministry
candidates.note: Christian dance studio advertised a separate summer 2025 class session.

candidates.name: The Performing Arts Company of Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 dance intensive for ages 8–18; additional musical-theater camps include dancing and circus skills.

candidates.name: LEAF Global Arts
candidates.note: 2026 youth arts camps explore dance, music, theater and visual arts from different cultures.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer offerings included Carolina Diva Diamondz dance sessions for ages 8–16 and general day camps.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2025–2026 themed performing-arts camps combine dance, singing and crafts with a weekly showcase.

candidates.name: Art of Dance Studio
candidates.note: 2026 half-day camps for ages 3+ and a June–July summer session in ballet, tap, jazz and other styles.

candidates.name: Legacy Dance Center
candidates.note: Advertised summer camps in 2025; studio is located at 115 Glance Street in Clyde.

candidates.name: MusicWorks! Studio of Performing Arts
candidates.note: 2026 three-day, half-day themed camps for ages 3–11 include ballet, jazz, hip-hop, tumbling and theater.

candidates.name: Johnson City Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 Princess Ballerina Camp and summer dance classes for level 3–7 dancers.
